sloka: कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम समाश्वसिहि सुव्रत ।दृष्टा देवी न सन्देहो न चान्येन हनूमता ।। ५.६४.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: kausalyā suprajā rāma samāśvasihi suvrata ।dṛṣṭā devī na sandeho na cānyena hanūmatā ।। 5.64.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "Hanuman is the one who has accomplished this task. Who else can? No doubt, he has seen Sita.
